tool_input.command:
cd /app && cat > boot_alpine.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Kill any existing QEMU processes
for pid in $(find /proc -maxdepth 2 -name cmdline 2>/dev/null -exec grep -l qemu {} \; 2>/dev/null | sed 's|/proc/\([0-9]*\)/.*|\1|' | sort -u); do
  kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null
done
sleep 2

# Start QEMU with serial input
rm -f qemu.log
nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 1024 -cdrom alpine.iso -drive file=alpine-disk.qcow2,format=qcow2 -net nic -net user,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -nographic > qemu.log 2>&1 &
QEMU_PID=$!
sleep 3

# Send boot command to QEMU via monitor
echo 'boot' | nc localhost 2222 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2
EOF
chmod +x boot_alpine.sh
echo 'Script created'

cd /app && find /proc -maxdepth 2 -name cmdline 2>/dev/null -exec grep -l qemu {} \; 2>/dev/null | sed 's|/proc/\([0-9]*\)/.*|\1|' | sort -u | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; cat > /tmp/boot_and_config.sh << 'BOOT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /app

# Kill any lingering QEMU
for pid in $(find /proc -maxdepth 2 -name cmdline 2>/dev/null -exec grep -l qemu {} \; 2>/dev/null | sed 's|/proc/\([0-9]*\)/.*|\1|'); do
  kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null || true
done
sleep 2

# Start QEMU with auto-timeout boot and serial console
rm -f qemu.log qemu.sock
nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 2048 -cdrom alpine.iso -net nic -net user -nographic -serial stdio > qemu.log 2>&1 &
QEMU_PID=$!
echo "QEMU PID: $QEMU_PID"
sleep 5

# Send 'boot' to auto-proceed
echo "boot" > /proc/$QEMU_PID/fd/0 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 10
echo "Boot command sent"
BOOT_EOF
chmod +x /tmp/boot_and_config.sh
echo 'Script ready'

    sleep 2
    echo "/etc/init.d/sshd start"
    sleep 5
